title: CGAP Human Lung Dissociation
author: Adam Hunter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qz9dx96
materials: Ensure all unused tissue, equipment and tubes that have been in contact with primary tissue are placed into Virkon in sweetie jar for a minimum of 1 hour. After this time aspirate and disposing in relevant sharps or waste routes.

steps.title: Section lung tissue
steps.instruction: Cut lung into 1 cm × 1 cm pieces weighing approximately 0.2 g each.

steps.title: Add digestion medium
steps.instruction: Place each tissue piece in a 10 cm petri dish and add ~250 µL Digestion Medium (DMEM supplemented with Collagenase D at 0.1 mL per mL and DNase I at 10 µL per mL) to fully cover the tissue.

steps.title: Finely mince tissue
steps.instruction: Using two scalpels, chop the tissue inside the dish (or tube) as finely as possible.

steps.title: Transfer to tube with digestion media
steps.instruction: Add ~2 mL Digestion Medium, then transfer the minced tissue to a 15 mL Falcon tube with a 5 mL stripette.

substeps.instruction: Wash the petri dish with 1 mL Digestion Medium and add the wash to the same Falcon tube.

steps.title: Incubate digestion
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 37 °C for 1 hour on a rocker; if the tissue originates from the lower left lobe, incubate for only 30 minutes. Optionally freeze the tissue at this point using isopentane (see CGAP Freezing protocol).

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the digested sample through a 100 µm nylon mesh into a 50 mL Falcon tube; repeatedly mash the mesh with a syringe plunger and rinse with cold Complete Medium (DMEM + 10 % FBS) up to a total volume of 25 mL.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 360 × g for 10 min at 4 °C (acceleration 4, brake 2).

steps.title: Resuspend in complete medium
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 25 mL cold Complete Medium.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge again at 360 × g for 10 min at 4 °C (acceleration 4, brake 2).

steps.title: Red blood cell lysis
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 1× Red Blood Cell Lysis solution to the pellet and incubate on ice for 5 min with periodic agitation.

steps.title: Wash with PBS
steps.instruction: Add cold PBS to a final volume of 10 mL, then centrifuge at 360 × g for 5 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Resuspend for counting
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final pellet in 1 mL 0.04 % BSA, then count cells.

steps.title: Assess viability and decide
steps.instruction: If live‑cell percentage is ≥70–80 %, proceed to single‑cell RNA‑seq; if lower, perform dead‑cell removal using the MACS Live/Dead Separation protocol.

steps.title: Prepare for 10X library
steps.instruction: Dilute cells to 2 × 10⁶ cells · mL⁻¹ in 0.04 % BSA and continue with the 10X Genomics scRNA‑seq workflow.
